hooks.name: fv-session-context
hooks.command: node "$GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR/.factory/bin/factory.mjs" gemini-adapter SessionStart -- node .factory/bin/factory.mjs hook session-start

hooks.name: fv-architecture-review
hooks.command: node "$GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR/.factory/bin/factory.mjs" gemini-adapter Stop -- node .factory/bin/factory.mjs hook stop

hooks.name: pipeline-story-guard
hooks.command: node "$GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR/.factory/bin/factory.mjs" gemini-adapter PreToolUse -- node .factory/bin/factory.mjs hook pre-tool

hooks.name: graphify-guard-search
hooks.command: node "$GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR/.factory/bin/factory.mjs" gemini-adapter PreToolUse -- graphify hook-guard search --strict

hooks.name: graphify-guard-read
hooks.command: node "$GEMINI_PROJECT_DIR/.factory/bin/factory.mjs" gemini-adapter PreToolUse -- graphify hook-guard read --strict
